reports.title: National Summary Data Page — Tanzania
reports.description: Tanzania's National Summary Data Page, published on the OpenData for Africa platform on behalf of the National Bureau of Statistics, following a 2016 IMF Statistics Department mission (per the IMF's own November 2016 press release) that helped develop it using the Open Data Platform installed with African Development Bank support. The page's own text states data on it correspond to the IMF's DSBB and that Tanzania participates in the enhanced General Data Dissemination System. The IMF's own dsbb.imf.org endpoint carries no NSDPUrl for e-GDDS participants (unlike SDDS/SDDS Plus), so this anchor is drawn from Tanzania's own site rather than the IMF's.
reports.cadence_note: Continuously updated data page, not a discrete-edition publication -- same renderer convention as bw-nsdp and in-nsdp (HANDOFF section 7, 2026-08-18): a nominal releases_per_year so the pulse reads as continuous rather than one-off.
